raw_text: Spectrum analysis of the GPS spoofing signals in the Indian Ocean region shows characteristics consistent with a military-grade spoofing system. Signal power levels and modulation patterns match documented Chinese EW capabilities. The spoofing is creating coherent false GPS signals that override legitimate satellite signals. Both L1 and L5 bands are affected. This requires significant RF power and suggests a ship-based or large platform source.
